WITH customer_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    COUNT(*) as order_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders) as order_share
  FROM Orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    order_count,
    order_share,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_share DESC) as rnk
  FROM customer_orders
)
SELECT 
  customer_id,
  order_count,
  order_share
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 10
ORDER BY order_share DESC, customer_id
